inspection_summary: Verified and inspected all 756 normalized lines. The article uses the exactly understood second moment as a model for diagnosing why long-Dirichlet-polynomial calculations of higher moments lose terms: it derives an exact shifted Fourier/Mellin identity, conditionally descends the shifted fourth-moment recipe into zero-, one-, and two-swap residue families, then ascends from coefficient correlations to identify the diagonal with zero swaps and Type I off-diagonals with one swap, leaving the correlations corresponding to two swaps as the explicit unresolved mechanism.

sections_inspected.label: Front matter and abstract
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: States the long-polynomial/divisor-correlation diagnostic and the claim that standard methods miss terms.

sections_inspected.label: Introduction
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Frames the failure beyond the eighth moment and the stress test using polynomials substantially longer than T.

sections_inspected.label: Second moment
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Compares the classical shifted mean square with the Goldston-Gonek coefficient-correlation formula and isolates the Fourier identity required for compatibility.

sections_inspected.label: General shifts and direct identity proof
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: States the shifted identity and proves it through Perron inversion, Fourier decomposition, the zeta functional equation, and contour residues.

sections_inspected.label: Fourth-moment target and polynomial model
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Records the six-term shifted fourth-moment formula, defines shifted divisor coefficients and their truncation, and asks how the truncated mean square approaches the moment.

sections_inspected.label: Descending through the recipe
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Uses a double Perron representation and a symmetry reduction to express the truncated mean square as a one-variable contour integral of the shifted-moment recipe, conditional on shift uniformity.

sections_inspected.label: Swap-count rule
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Classifies the six recipe terms by zero, one, or two swaps and relates swap count to the direction of contour motion and length thresholds.

sections_inspected.label: Explicit zero- and one-swap terms
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Computes diagonal and one-swap residues and exhibits a cancellation between their cutoff-dependent contributions.

sections_inspected.label: Explicit two-swap terms
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Computes the two-swap residue family and shows how summing all swap classes removes X-dependence once the polynomial is sufficiently long.

sections_inspected.label: Ascending diagonal
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Rewrites the coefficient mean square and identifies its diagonal Perron series exactly with the zero-swap term.

sections_inspected.label: Ascending Type I off-diagonals
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Applies a shifted-divisor correlation model and the earlier transform identity to match four Type I off-diagonal terms with the four one-swap terms.

sections_inspected.label: Conclusion and missing correlation family
sections_inspected.mathematical_role: Locates the unresolved contribution beyond X greater than T squared in divisor correlations that must correspond to two swaps and displays the coupled correlation constraints proposed for the next analysis.
